gloss: the current month; the month in question

definitions.explanation: The month being talked about, usually the present one: a formal, businesslike word found in invoices, notices and reports, where everyday speech would say {今月|こんげつ}.

examples.japanese: {当月|とうげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧。
⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当月|とうげつ}{末|まつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pay the charge by the end of the current month.

examples.japanese: {当月|とうげつ}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The invoice for this month will arrive by the fifth of the following month.

notes:
{当|とう}- means "this, the one in question" (as in ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧, ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧). In a document about a past month, {当月|とうげつ} means that month, not the present one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当月|とうげつ}{末|まつ}: the end of the current month
- {当月|とうげつ}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: the amount for this month
- {当月|とうげつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: within the month

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧: this month — the everyday word
- ⟦{前月|ぜんげつ}→前月：21207_zengetsu⟧ / ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧: the previous / following month — its formal companions
